integrity: The all-dimension statement is proved analytically. Finite matrix calculations are used only as replayable corroboration. Earlier privacy-test and Bell-target overlap bounds are credited and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem calibrates the local decoded privacy-test overlap lemma, not the complete strong-converse exponent; it does not classify equality cases under reduced receiver-shield dimensions.
title: Sharpness of the shared-receiver dimension factor in privacy-test overlap
